balls.text: spanked straight back to the bowler, who gets some hand on it and they are back for a second to long-off
wow, was that a half-helicopter? it was a full-toss and he gets a lot of bottom hand on it, cracked over wide long-on for a six!

this is good bowling, he's managing to follow Tiwary, he was looking to go over to the off side and scoop it over the short fine-leg but he bowls it very full and wide outside the off, single to that same fielder
chips it over the off side, was a fuller one but he can get it only to deep point for a single
short of length and that's whacked over the mid-wicket for a four, gets off the mark
way outside the off stump, he was looking to walk across to the off side but he follows him and the batsman can only get some bat on it for a single
slower one again and he wants to cut it, but the new man's beaten for pace and it's through to the keeper
slower one and he was looking to go down the track, does not get any bat on it, they are able to sneak a single
edged and through to the keeper on the bounce, but it's given a wide, he didn't hear it!

this is what he should do, this is what he has done! it short of length and he wants to pull it away, gets a top-edge and that goes high in the air and is caught rather well by the short fine-leg fielder
blasted it through wide long-off for a four, that's fuller and outside the off and he walks across and smash it goes, what does the bowler do now?
full-toss outside the off stump and with the third-man inside the circle, he will be cursing himself there, should have got it away to the fence, single to short third-man
smart shot that from Tiwary, almost puts the bowler into a quandary here, it was on the off stump, perfect length too but he goes out and scoops it over short fine-leg for a four
swing away from the bat, drives it to extra-cover and they are able to get away for a single
thick edge and that's cracked over point for a four, good runs added here
cracked it, but it was not off the middle and the shot goes to the left of Rasool at deep square-leg, he was running backward and not going for a catch
quicker, outside the off and full-toss, is able to tap it down to long-off for a single
over the top, tries to go inside out and has been able to crack it towards the deep cover fielder for a single
outside the off and cuts it to the backward point, they are off for a quick one
round the stumps now and Tendo is able to muscle it to long-on for a single
four more, what batting this, where was he all this while! it was outside the off stump and the yorker was converted into a low full-toss, gets it over the short cover fielder for a four
this time he succeeds! he was looking to get runs in every part of the ground I think, drills it straight back to the bowler, four between long-on and long-off
first to the leg, then to the off, and now he goes to hit it straight over, misses, straight to the keeper
and now he gets the width he needs to free his arms again, this time he cuts hard and gets it to the left of the sweeper, a couple
shot, that's his first six this IPL, it was fuller outside the off and he free his arms, smacks it over the mid-wicket area for a six!
shuffles across to the off stump and gives the impression he wants to hit it over the leg side but then cuts it hard, straight to the third-man fielder for a single
appeal for an lbw, he was looking to defend it, bit of movement back into him, hits the pads and they are off for a leg-bye
edged and gone, Pathan's stay is a short one length ball outside the off stump, he wants to go for a hard-hit cut, what he ends up doing instead is to nick it straight to the keeper
slower, fuller and he plonks his bat and pad out and defends, to the fielder
fuller on the off side and he goes down the ground, single to long-off
length ball and defended to the off side
slower and hits it to long-on for a single
slows it down but Pathan does well to get it down to third-man for a single, Rasool runs in quickly to field it
bouncer, well bowled and Pathan's gone down under it, done well too, it's called a wide in the end
slows it down considerably and pulls back the length too, pushes it to backward square-leg and they are able to come back for the second now
fuller on the off stump and driven, straight to the short cover fielder
cramps him for room, on the off stump and angle into the batsman, defended back to the bowler
shorter in length, not a slower ball this time and it's easily nurdled around to the leg side for a single

tries to slog it away but it's gone straight to Mathews at short mid-wicket, Gambhir's gone! Big big wicket for the Warriors, he wanted to slog it over the in-field but does not connect it too well, simple catch for the fielder
fuller outside the off stump, 129.8 km/hr and that's drilled through the covers for a single
quicker outside the off stump, defended to the off side and Mathews has a shy at the non-striker's stumps, misses
slower on his pads and tucks it away to the leg side for a couple
a very slow ball used to guide it to third-man for that single which brings him his 50, his 20th in IPL history.
fuller on the off stump, slower too and pushed down the ground for a single
flicked through to deep mid-wicket get him a couple of runs after Rasool misfields, moves on to 49

goes for a slog against the line and misses. Misses the stumps. Misses the keeper. And what it does hit is the boundary rope and for four byes. the keeper was blinded by Gambhir walking in front of him I think
very full and angling into the batsman who looks to flick it away, gets an inside edge on to the boot
slower but pitched right up to the bat, Gambhir thinks of blasting it away before checking the stroke and getting it over extra-cover for a couple of runs
quicker this time, cramps him for room who is looking to flick it to the leg side, does not get any bat on it
slows it down well and he's still able to tuck it down towards fine-leg and they come back for the second
and this time he does get an edge that goes on the bounce to the keeper
outside the off and beats the outside of the bat, was looking to defend at it but too quick for him

gone, caught, Morgan's got to walk back! he was looking to flick it over the short fine-leg fielder, he seemed to have got it fairly well in the middle of the bat but the gap is what he fails to find, straight to the fielder and they have lost another
opens the face of the bat and through to the third-man for a single
shorter in length and wanted to cut it away, beats the outside edge of the bat, through to the keeper
a slower one first up and after looking to go through the off side, he checks his shot and drives it to long-on for a single
shortish, quicker and slapped to long-on for a single to finish off an excellent spell from Rasool
shorter in length, not too much turn and easily played away to the leg side
flicked it away to the mid-wicket region for a single
was looking to cut it away there, but the ball keeps low and there is a huge appeal from the keeper, a long, long one in fact, not-out given
slightly shorter in length that allows him to tuck it to wide long-on for an easy couple of runs
tucked away to the deep mid-wicket region for a couple of runs
slower one and he had to check his stroke, plays it straight in the end and gets a single to long-off
shorter in length and punched back to the bowler, who fields on his right
and this angles into the batsman, who opens the face of the bat and taps it through to third-man
shorter in length but a slower one too and GG likes what he sees, cuts it away through backward point for a couple
slows it down this time, pitches it up to the bat, and tucked to the leg side for another single
short of length from Mathews and pulled away to the deep square-leg fielder for a single
and now the reverse shot, is hit in the gap and goes for a four, wasn't too hard again, but the placement is the key there
drives it down the ground, was in the air because he did not quite get close to the pitch but on bounce
tries to paddle it over the fine-leg region, seems to have come off his pads through to the keeper
quicker from the bowler, hits it down the ground for a single
wants to reverse hit this one, gets it off the middle but not powerfully enough, to the point fielder
round the stumps, on the middle stump, spins away from the bat, defended
and again, short of length, slower and the cut goes straight to Yuvi at point, well fielded
cuts hard and through to the right of Yuvraj at point, who dives well, fields and throws it back to the keeper, needed a direct hit
was looking to walk down and tap it to the off side, it hits his bat hard and rolls over to the keeper, GG does not know where the ball is, sent back
length ball on the middle stump and the new man Morgan has patted it down to long-on for a single
another one that's slower, another one that's guided down to third-man for a single
slow one to begin with, outside the off stump and it's tapped straight to the point area
first wicket for Rasool, Kallis' gone! it was fuller this time and he's picked out  Mathews at short cover, straight to him, who needs a second attempt to catch it
it's tad wide, wants to drive it away but I thought I spotted a bit of drift there
quicker on his pads, was looking to tuck it away to the leg side but does not get any bat on it, rolls away for a leg-bye
continues to bowl quicker here and he's tapped it to the off side for a single
fuller yet again and pushed back to the bowler
quicker, flatter, straighter and defended back to the right of the bowler
short of length and that's cracked away through the backward point area, there were two of them there and easily bisects them.
outside the off stump, slightly slower and beats the outside edge, the keeper fumbles too
on the middle stump line and he was looking to flick it away, was pitching outside the leg and hits his pads
and Kallis does a Gambhir, stands up tall and guides it to third-man for a single to get off the mark

goes for a whack across the line, misses and the bails are quickly whipped by the keeper, third-umpire called. whoa, that's gone, he seemed to have got his foot back but the part that is grounded is outside the crease and the one that's in the air is over the crease, which means that the umpire Taufel has no hesitation in giving it out!
short of length, outside the off stump and you can take a guess at where it's gone, pushed through to third-man for a single
quicker and flatter, pushes it back to the right of the bowler who does well to get to it
shortens his length yet again and patted it to long-on for a single
shorter from the bowler and the batsman was looking to tap it and run, but bit of a leading edged takes it back to the bowler
fuller this time and it's a false stroke that goes to the fence, whether it's good batting or false strokes, his favourite area remains the same, that V behind the stumps
opens his stance up and hits it inside out and for a four, that's the first four off Rasool in the IPL
outside the off stump, floats it up and driven to the point region

wow, he just cannot help himself playing that stroke now, can he, slightly outside the off stump and the next thing you know is that he's opened the face and guided it through to third-man for a single
and yet again, it was a shorter ball after the batsman went down the track, is able to crack it through to third-man for a single
not this time, no outside edge this time, he has given the charge yet again and whack he goes, over the extra-cover region for a four
and now he was looking to charge the bowler and hit it over the top, bit of an outside edge to point
length ball on the off stump and it's patted to the point fielder
fuller on the off stump and GG wont stop playing that one, open face, guide to third-man, get a single
and he repeats that stroke, opens the face and dabs it to third-man, this is a much more controlled stroke than that previous one and it rolls over for a single
good length this time and on the middle stump too, bit of angle back in and easily tucked away to fine-leg for a single
short of length and Bisla is going to go after it, rocks back and pulls it away over mid-wicket for a four
on a length and tapped to the on-side, off for a quick single
edged and gone off the bounce to the keeper, was looking to deliberately open the face of the bat like he usually likes to do
on his pads, very full and that's caressed by GG, flicked away through the backward square-leg area for a four, the fine-leg fielder did give it a chase but that's too quick for him
and now opens the face of the bat and guides it through to third-man for a single
hit hard, with a lot of authority, he walks down and gives it a serious tap down the ground for a four, beats the mid-off easily
up and over and for a four, this is another fuller one from the bowler, GG was looking to carve it over the point region, gets it over cover and for a four
wider outside the off stump and he tries to get some bat on that one too, bit of a stifled appeal from the keeper
length ball on his pads, easily flicked away to wide mid-on for a single
almost floats it up outside the off stump, pretty wide and too and he does well to get some bat on it, drilled through point for three, the ball pretty much stops before getting to the fence
on a good length and on the off stump, Gambhir taps and runs much like he would with Sehwag in the good days they had together at the top of the Indian innings
shorter one down the leg side, this seemed to have some pace on it and almost had GG in a bit of bother but the poor line helps
crunch, it's off the middle of the bat and while it's straight to mid-off fielder, he will feel good with that stroke
down the leg side, again tries to keep it up to the bat but misses his line, goes down for a wide
this time he walks down the track, pushes it to mid-on and they are away for a quick single, good throw back from Yuvi and hits the stumps, but a diving Bisla is back in
fuller yet again, and this time he taps it back to the bowler
up to the bat yet again and driven straighter this time to mid-off, not for runs
fuller outside the off stump and immediately driven off the middle of the bat, tapped to the off side

whoa, what a catch! Balaji has taken a ripper! he was looking to go down the track and smash it back, the ball was a slower one and never came on to him, still manages to get a decent part of the bat on it, Balaji springs his hand out and grabs a superb catch, reflex, one-handed effort!
on his pads and tucked away to the leg side for a single

bowled him, sneaks through his defences this time! he was looking to play it off the back foot but the ball's gone so low that there was no way he was getting close to it from that position, beaten and the off-stump's lying flat
ooh, tries to cut it away, it's a tad too quick for him and turning away too, beats the outside edge
opens the face of the bat and pushes it to the point fielder for a single
defended on the front foot and straight back to the bowler
goes down the track and Narine immediately shortens his length, can only tap it to the off side for a single
defended off the front foot to the off side
and now Narine gets one, it was fuller on the off stump and hit straight to long-off, easily caught by Tiwary

edged and taken this time, Kallis does look back at the umpire who raises his finger that time! bouncer, outside the off stump but gets nowhere close to the middle, through to the keeper who takes a simple one
slows it down to his countryman does Kallis and a forward defensive prod gets him a single to the off side
shorter and slower and he throws the bat at it, quite hard at that but only for a single
slower one and pulled away to the mid-wicket fielder for a single

pulled but not off the middle, the fielder at mid-wicket inside the circle was running towards his right and he takes some long steps, dives to his right too, gets his hand but fails to latch on, does Bhatia
short of length and punched to the off side, through for a single to point
wants to sweep it away by getting outside the off stump, misses the bat and hits his pads, thankfully there's no appeal this time
shorter in length and turning away now, punched to long-off for a single
big appeal for a caught behind, that was turning back into the batsman and it beats him, goes between the bat and the pad and replays suggest it came off the thigh guard to the keeper
waits for it and pushes it to the off side this time
first delivery, on the middle stump and he tries to reverse sweep it, not off the middle and a single to what was originally his off side

shorter and caught at long-on! he was looking to slog it away, did not get it off the middle of the bat because of the lack of pace, manages to only chip it to long-on and easily caught at long-on, a good knock but came too late
this is slightly wider and he goes after it, does not get any elevation but it runs to the wide long-on region for a single
and again, that's the fourth six of the innings for Mathews, it was fuller and on the off stump and he hits it straight, over the bowler and for a six!
hooked away for a six! it was almost as if he was waiting for the bouncer and went after it, got a bit of a top-edge but still clears the long-leg field for a six!
yorker length after those first couple of shorter ones, slower ball too and Mathews fails to get his bat down in time, through to the keeper
short of good length and he cuts it through to third-man for a single
shortish in length and he throws his bat at it, gets an outside edge that runs away through to fine third-man for a single, Narine dives at the ball and somehow manages to stop it
it's shorter in length and he can only defend it back towards the off side
slower and shorter and cuts straight to deep cover for a single
shorter in length and he half-pulls, half-forehands it to long-on for a single.
shorter from Narine and tapped to the backward point fielder
goes for another sweep and misses, goes for a stumping and appeals but he's in
loud, loud appeal for an lbw where the ball has hit the pads miles outside the off

and now Marsh has holed out to long-on! he was left with no option but to go over the top, it was a slower one from Bhatia and he was looking to hit it over long-on, does not get a lot of bat on it and it's well taken at the boundary
shorter in length and he's played it down to long-on for a single
another shorter one for Marsh who loves to cut them but with the ball not coming on, it runs over to the deep covers only
on his pads, cramps him again who taps it to deep square-leg for a single
hits it over long-on and that's gone all the way for a six, just eludes the high-jumping fielder there
slows it down again and he was looking to crash it over the leg side, has to defend back to the bowler

he is floating them up and bowling them very wide, wide enough to be called wide if they leave them alone but both are trying to go after him, this time Mathews can only toe-end it to long-on for a single
slower, shorter and Marsh again unleashes that cut, straight to the deep cover fielder
and now flights it up outside the off stump, he wants to go over but slices it and lands in front of Balaji, who misfields
very short, very wide and Marsh goes after it, the cut travels as far as the deep cover for a single
on his pads to cramp him up and he drives it down to mid-wicket for a single
shot sir, this has been dispatched over long-on for a six, bowled very full and Mathews take full toll
on his pads, full-toss and flicked to deep square-leg for a single
on his pads and it's hit to mid-wicket for a single
straight hit to the stumps and there's nothing on the ball this time, the bowler's boot is a long way off from it
was going down the track but the length is immediately shortened and tucked to deep square-leg for a single
fuller on the middle stump, quicker this time and pushes it to long-on for a single
slows it down considerably as is his wont, and he checks his shot, pats it to the off side for a single
slower, shorter and defended on the front foot to the off side.
gone this time, cut straight to backward point! it was shorter in length and he wanted to cut it, doesn't get it off the middle of the bat, and it's a gentle lob for the fielder
and now Mathews hits it in no-man's land, slower again and mistimed over the covers

and that's a miss, not a drop, but a miss for sure! it was a slower one from Abdulla, he was looking to play through the line, but the lack of pace does him and the ball lobs up high and falls between Kallis coming in and Morgan going out
was giving himself room, can barely tap it away to the off side
shimmy down the ground and lofted right over the bowler's head, the long-on and long-off fielders converge and Kallis fields it well
very full from the bowler, and it's tapped down to long-on for a single
slower one, pushed to the off side for a single
slower and on the middle, he was looking to chip it over the leg side, had he missed that, would have been a loud appeal, he manages to chip it where he wants to
outside the off stump and he goes to cut it, keeps a tad low, bounces over to the point fielder
fuller on the off stump and driven down to long-off for a single

that's outside the off stump and not too quick, tapped to Pathan who has a go at the non-striker's end and it's hit the bowler hard on the wrist, he's not happy, not a day to be a happy one for some cricketers
short of length and tapped straight to extra-cover, again not for runs
shortens his length this time and some bounce for him, Mathews loves taking his bottom hand off it and he does just that, defended to the leg side
again full enough but Uthappa taps and runs away, it went to Gambhir who decides not to throw
fullish this time after the first two were a tad short, taps it to the off side but straight to the fielder
short of length and punched to the off side for a single
slowish on the off stump, short of length too, tapped to mid-on for a single
fuller in length and he carefully taps it down to long-on for a single
shorter in length and tapped down the ground for a single
bowls it fuller this time, he gets his bat and pad out and defends back
shorter in length and punched back to the bowler, who does well to field it
fuller in the length and he gets his front foot out, defends it back to the bowler
bowled him, a scratchy innings comes to an end! bit of turn away from the batsman, it was not full enough to play that sweep shot, misses and it spins away enough to take the off stump
shorter in length and outside the off, this is a slower ball as well and he rolls his wrist over it, single to the leg side
the batsman does not know whether to go forward or back, in the end, he remains rooted and pushes it back, it was on a length and on the off stump line
fuller within the stumps and Uthappa's playing them in the V, tapped back down the ground for a single
and now down the leg side for a wide, was looking to flick it away but does not get anything on it and they get a wide
slower one from Balaji, he's not bowled a lot of them today, it;s outside the off stump and the batsman's very early in his shot, beats the under edge
shorter in length and defended on the back foot, pushed into the covers
angles into the batsman and he's immediately out and pushing it to the mid-off fielder for a single
cracking shot, was going back and expected it to turn away from him, makes a good sound off the bat too and gets it through the gap for a four
goes for a slog sweep, misses the bat and hits the pads, appeal for an lbw
fuller this time and a much more placid Birla defends it back to the bowler
looks to heave it away to the off side, spins away and beaten
again that good length, defended back to the bowler
edged and fell short of the slip? it seemed to have spun quickly from the batsman, gets an edge and could have carried to Kallis in the slips? No, bounces just before...
on his pads this time and easily tucked way to deep square-leg for a single
on the off stump, on a good length, pushed to mid-off for a single
short of length and cut away to third-man for a single
whoa, on fire is the bowler, it's short of length and the batsman's looking to play it off the back foot, gets no edge through to the keeper
slower one outside the off stump, taps it in an attempt to find a gap but a diving cover fielder stops it
another bouncer from JK, a quick one too, and he wants to hook it away, beats the top-edge through to the keeper
a fired up Kallis bowls a bouncer, it's gone quickly past the batsman but the umpire calls it a no-ball for the front foot, free-hit time!
fullish length and on the middle stump, he pats it back to mid-on
on his pads and it's pushed to mid-on for a single
outside the off stump and swinging away from the bat, gets it through to the third-man for a single
edged and gone, given! Yuvi's poor form continues, it was on the off stump and he was looking to defend it, gets bit of a nick to the keeper and he's gone!
fullish on the middle stump, driven down gently for a single
short of length outside the off stump and patted to the off side
on the pads, middle stump and that's tucked to the leg side for a single
slower on his pads and that's tucked away to the leg side for a single

bowled him, Kallis has his man this time and no need for the third ump to decide on that one! short of length and it seems to have kept a tad low, he was looking to play off the back foot, almost stuck there without any feet and it's gone through, the off pole it on the ground, and Kallis looks back with a look that...well, could kill.
shorter in length, tapped to the off side for a quickly taken single to point
fuller on the off stump, driven to short cover and straight to him, not for runs

appeal for a run-out, driven back to the bowler and it seems to have come off his foot and hit the stumps at the other end. the batsman seems to be outside his crease which means that the third-umpire needs to be fully certain that it's hit the bowler's boot. the thing here is that Kallis is confident it's hit his boot but nothing on the replays can convince anyone that's flicked the shoe, and given not-out! Kallis is the second man today to be a very, very angry man, arguing a lot with the umpire, for a change, Gambhir is only looking on, not saying much.
outside the off stump and on a length, wanted to cut it but straight to the point fielder
up and over the bowler for a four, it's pitched right up to the bat and he goes through the line of the ball and hits it away
shorter in length and he's trying to get it quicker too, 128.5 km/hr and Finch defends it off the back foot
on the middle stump and he taps it gently to the leg side for a single
short of length and beats the outside edge of the bat, through to the keeper
another one that's down the leg side and this time it's quicker, does not get any bat on it, wide called

poor delivery, that's well wide down the leg side and Uthappa could have let that go, instead the in-form batsman tries to flick it away, gets one hand off it as well and it rolls away over the in-field for a four!
fuller this time and on his pads, works it away to wide mid-on for a couple but there's a bit of a strange piece of fielding there that allows them to come back for the third
shorter in length and he taps it hard into the ground, back to the bowler
quicker on his pads and that's flicked down to deep square-leg for a single
continues to pull his length back and he tucks it to the leg side for a single
shorter in length yet again and that's cracked through to the cover fielder
very short from the spinner and he's jabbed it over mid-wicket for a four, just eludes the diving Kallis at mid-wicket
